C0984.title: Peacekeeper Elite Spectator Wallhack Enforcement Notice (Feb 2020)
C0984.summary: On February 19, 2020, Game for Peace issued a notice targeting the exploit where low-ranked alternate accounts use wallhacks to spectate high-ranked main accounts. The official spectator system was upgraded to block this behavior, with support for automated detection and offline retroactive bans. Penalty rules were also refined: accounts flagged for malicious spectating first receive a warning and a 10-minute match ban, or are forced to disable 'allow others to spectate'; once cheating is confirmed, the maximum penalty is a 3650-day ban.
